gap: No result ChatGPT got states that the same Carpuride screen is sold under the same name as a cheaper SKU with no rear camera ($129.99 C98 vs $149.99 with camera; $169.99 C92 vs $189.99), that the rear cameras are model-specific (a $30 add-on chosen by device), or that Carpuride's WF01 wireless rear camera ($129.99) cannot be used with the W903, C92 or C98.
standout_why: I compared against the pages I could open. cartechtalk.com lists IIWEY iK7, HAUXIY Q9S and Krunia, with no Carpuride. rottenwifi.com already gives the W903 split ($219.99 front camera only vs $249.99 dual camera) and says to confirm the bundle. gearnudge.com prices the C98 at $149.99 and the C92 at $189.99, the with-camera SKUs, but never says camera-less SKUs exist $20 cheaper. carcody.com covers stand-alone cameras and generic Amazon screens. ChatGPT's own answer already warns to 'make sure the package includes the rear camera'. None of these state the $20 C98/C92 SKU split, the $30 model-specific replacement camera, or the WF01 incompatibility. Car and Driver and Autoweek blocked the fetch; DashGear Lab and ScoutVetted failed with a certificate error. So the part about checking the bundle is already out there, and only the specific prices and incompatibility are new.
decides: It confirms ChatGPT's warning and makes it concrete. In the Carpuride line the camera adds $20 to $30, so a shopper must pick the 'With Backup Camera' or 'Dual Cameras' listing. A front-camera W903 ($219.99) can't be fixed later with Carpuride's wireless rear camera. On price for a camera in the box, the cheapest kits I could verify are the HIEHA 7-inch at $59.99 (maker's store) and the generic Amazon 9-inch at $84.99 (sold as HAUXIY Q9S per cartechtalk). Carpuride's C98 with camera at $149.99 is the cheapest named-brand kit from the maker's store. Our Eonon UA13 Plus ($95.99 on Amazon) is an in-dash double-DIN head unit, not a portable screen, and I could not confirm that a camera comes in the box.
